Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo invite. Quick update from our side: procurement has put a temporary hold on product demos for third-party vendors until we complete vendor onboarding and a basic security review (NDA + questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence). I wanted to be transparent so we don't block your team's time.

I'm traveling next week (11/9–11/13) and procurement is asking for the completed questionnaire and an executed NDA before they'll approve a live demo with engineering present. Can you: 
- Share your standard NDA and a contact for security evidence (SOC 2, pen test summary)?
- Share the vendor onboarding checklist if you have one so we can work internally?

If we get those items in the next week, procurement estimates they can clear us for a demo the week of 11/16. Otherwise we'll need to push to the following week. Apologies for the back-and-forth — trying to keep stakeholders aligned.

Best,
Morgan Park

Brightwell Health

Subject: Vendor onboarding timeline and docs required

Vanessa / Morgan,

Thanks for sending the NDA and checklist. A few clarifications from procurement: 
- We require an executed mutual NDA before scheduling any technical demos where PHI may be discussed.
- Completion of the questionnaire + submission of SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) is required. If SOC 2 is redacted, provide a summary of controls and contact for SOC 2 inquiries.
- Our typical turnaround to clear a vendor after submission is ~7 business days (may vary depending on holidays).

I've attached our internal vendor onboarding checklist for your reference. Please send the SOC 2 evidence and any pen test summaries to procurement@brightwellhealth.com. We will review and come back with any follow-ups.

Procurement Team
Brightwell Health
